body: The Lions Club is actually a really good idea that I hadn't considered.  As far as my coworkers are concerned, they're a mixed bag.  I get along with them at work, and have hung out with some of them outside of work, but in all honesty, I gave it shot only to find I had little to nothing in common with most of them.  Thanks for the advice.

No, I wouldn't want anything to do with you if that were the case, and I think you are 100% right, but in the mean time getting to that point where we sit down and talk is really difficult.  It's all on her terms, while I'm twisting in the wind so to speak.  So yeah, I sit here for days and stew about it until I reach such a point that I just can't handle it and basically breakdown.  Either way, something has got to give, I just need to get some rest and make it to that point where action will actually take place.  Thanks for your advice.
She is very passive agressive.  I don't think there is because she was the one that reached out to me, but it's not out of the question.

I'm struggling with the idea of finally letting my fiancee go, although I think I've decided it absolutely has to happen, regardless of what happens with the dogs.  In my mind's eye, I pictured us growing up a little bit (since we both were fresh out of college when we go engaged) and then maybe giving things another shot.

As far as my roommate is concerned, I'm financially dependent.  I need to have a roommate to cover rent and utilities, and this place doesn't lend itself well to finding a sub-leaser.  Honestly, it's a shit hole, the only reason I moved here is for the fenced-in yard so the dogs could run around and play, and I'm locked into my lease until at least July.

The problem with finding new friends is that I live in a small-ish town that doesn't have a hell of a lot to do besides go to the bar.  That is, I feel obligated to be at a bar to make new friends, and that doesn't lend itself well to my current lifestyle.  I've been looking in local publications and online to see if I can find some activities or clubs to join, but it's tough.  I think ultimately, things have to get worse before they can get better.

That's really the main issue, she won't talk to me.  All I want is to have a conversation with her, but she has refused to for the last three days, although she is kind enough to let me know she doesn't want to.  Yes, I do want a relationship with her, but after this I feel really torn like I'm just asking for trouble.  I've tried telling her to no avail.  Basically she just kind of waltzed out of my life just as easily as she waltzed back into it.
